Top 6 most beautiful places you should visit at least once in your life, and to know more about those places, let’s go through the detailed places below with Vietlook Travel.

Vietnam welcomes visitors with famous landscapes, festivals, and special events. In addition, there are also famous tourist destinations, beautiful stops for every vacation, bustling cities, vast rice fields, rivers reflecting shadows, clear streams, fierce waterfalls, surrounded by majestic mountains creating a poetic picture, making Vietnam tours increasingly rich and diverse.

If this is your first time coming to Vietnam, let’s take a look at the top 6 most beautiful tourist destinations to have the most memorable vacation in Vietnam. Today, Vietlook Travel will suggest to you.

Hanoi

With a long history, diverse culture and unique ancient architecture, Hanoi is one of the destinations with many historical relics, traditional craft villages and spiritual places.

Hanoi’s climate is divided into 4 different seasons. Each season, the capital brings its own beauty so you can visit Hanoi at any time of the year. Besides the hustle and bustle of urban life, there is still an ancient and peaceful corner of Hanoi from ancient times.

The time from autumn to early winter is the most attractive time to visit Hanoi. At this time, the weather is no longer hot, the air is cool and fresh, Hanoi’s autumn with rows of trees with beautiful leaves, the streets are covered with yellow leaves. If you are a lover of romantic space, travel to Hanoi in the fall.

When you come to Hanoi, visit the following attractions:

Hanoi Old Quarter: A place with many small streets, narrow alleys, ancient houses, traditional cafes, preserving many cultural values ​​of the capital.

Thang Long Imperial Citadel – World Cultural Heritage: an important historical relic and a symbol of Hanoi.

Temple of Literature – Quoc Tu Giam: The first university in Vietnam and a place that preserves many cultural and historical values ​​of the country.

Hoan Kiem Lake: Come here, take a walk by the lake to admire the scenery and enjoy snacks around the lake, capturing the most beautiful moments, especially in the autumn weather.

One Pillar Pagoda is a famous pagoda with a long history and special architecture

Vietnam Museum of Ethnology: A place to display and preserve many cultural artifacts of Vietnamese ethnic groups.

Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum: A place to remember and honor the great leader of Vietnam.

Hanoi Opera House was built in the 20th century, is the place where many art and cultural performances of the country take place

In addition, Hanoi also welcomes visitors with famous places such as: Ba Den Tower, Turtle Tower, Huong Pagoda, Dong Xuan Market, Tay Ho Street, … Surely Hanoi will not disappoint you when visiting and exploring.

Son Doong Cave

Do you want to visit and explore a mysterious place? Son Doong Cave is a special cave that many tourists seek out, especially those who want to challenge themselves and explore mysteries.

The cave has a giant tunnel with water flowing through it. In the soft rock sections, the cave ceiling collapses to form holes, becoming a cave dome, and is a unique heritage, the largest natural cave, with a unique environment inside, with primeval forests and underground river systems.

It can be said that the cave is a magnificent masterpiece of nature, with giant stalactites hanging from the cave ceiling or protruding from the ground, looking like strangely shaped alien creatures.

Phu Quoc

Phu Quoc is an island famous for its long white sand beaches and magnificent luxury resorts, one of the must-see destinations when traveling to Vietnam to explore the beauty from North to South.

National Geographic once honored Phu Quoc as one of the 3 most beautiful winter destinations. It also topped the list of 10 most ideal beach destinations in Asia by AsiaOne.

Coming to Phu Quoc, you will encounter poetic beaches such as Bai Dai, Bai Sao and other pristine beaches. Coming here, visitors can not only enjoy swimming but also experience walking on the seabed and visit the following places:

Vinpearl Safar Phu Quoc is a zoo and conservation park. Visitors will see more than 3,000 animals of 150 different species. Most are free to roam, while dangerous species live in fenced areas.

Japanese Pearl Farm: Learn about pearl production and buy cultured pearls as souvenirs.

Phu Quoc Prison Historical Site: Learn about the war crimes of the US empire.

Tranh Stream: Hike, swim in the stream and enjoy the cool water from Ham Ninh mountain range.

In addition, Phu Quoc pearl island also has many interesting activities such as diving, fishing, yachting, enjoying local cuisine and visiting factories producing fish sauce, a famous specialty.

Saigon

Visiting the magnificent Saigon, tourists can feel all the beauty that the city brings to visitors. In particular, Saigon also welcomes visitors with diverse cultural, spiritual, natural attractions…

With a rich history and many attractive tourist destinations, Saigon is a destination not to be missed when traveling Vietnam. Below are the attractions you should visit when coming to Saigon:

Independence Palace: A remarkable architectural work, built in 1966, where the President of the Republic of Vietnam as well as the President of North Korea once visited.

  • Ben Thanh Market: One of the traditional markets in Saigon, with many attractive and diverse goods
  • Tao Dan Park: Located right in the city center, is a place for everyone to relax and exercise.
  • Saigon Notre Dame Cathedral: A beautiful architectural work built in the 19th century, a place of worship for Catholics
  • Nguyen Hue Walking Street: The city’s main street with many entertainment, shopping and culinary activities
  • Saigon Fine Arts Museum: Displaying many works of art by international and Vietnamese artists.

In addition, Saigon also has many other tourist attractions such as: Bui Vien Western Street, Ton That Thiep Street, Saigon Night Market, Ngoc Hoang Temple, Opera House will bring you an interesting vacation when visiting this city.

Hoi An

If you are planning to visit Vietnam’s famous landmarks, Hoi An is an indispensable destination in your itinerary, where there are many ancient architectural works and preserve the ancient Vietnamese culture, the ideal time to visit the old town is from February to April.

Hoi An is recognized by UNESCO as a World Cultural Heritage. With picturesque scenery, ancient architecture and diverse culture, Hoi An is currently an attractive destination for domestic and international tourists to visit, below are the places to visit in Hoi An that you should visit at least once in your life.

Hoi An Ancient Town: Located right in the city center, with ancient buildings, retail shops, restaurants and cafes, it is a check-in point chosen by many tourists.

  • Japanese Bridge: One of the symbols of the city, with unique architecture and legendary history.
  • Phung Hung Ancient House: One of the oldest houses in Hoi An, built in the 18th century and preserved to this day.
  • Hoi An Museum is a place to preserve and display works of art, artifacts and documents related to the history and culture of the city.
  • Ba Thien Hau Pagoda is one of the largest pagodas in Hoi An, with unique architecture and beautiful works of art.
  • Thanh Ha Pottery Village is located about 3km from the city center and is the place where traditional ceramics of Hoi An are produced and traded.

In addition, Hoi An also has traditional craft villages, An Bang or Cua Dai beaches, where visitors can enjoy local specialties of Hoi An. So it can be said that Hoi An is one of the great places to explore for those who love customs, culture, history and ancient architecture.

Ha Giang

One of the ideas in the journey to discover the beauty of the Northwest arc, where there are ancient towns, festivals but the blooming flower seasons, or winding and dangerous mountain passes are destinations for tourists who love and admire the peaceful scenery.

Here are the outstanding tourist attractions in Ha Giang:

  • Ma Pi Leng Pass: One of the most famous passes in Vietnam, with a steep slope that always challenges drivers, from the pass, visitors can admire the wild nature of the rocky plateau.
  • Meo Kings Temple Area: This mausoleum and temple area is dedicated to the Meo Kings – an ancient tribe in Ha Giang. This is one of the places that preserves many special values ​​about the history, architecture, and culture of the locality.
  • Lung Tam Waterfall: A majestic waterfall with white foam all year round, visitors will encounter a pristine and beautiful scene.
  • Dong Van Market: A traditional weekly market in Dong Van, attracting many tourists to visit and experience traditional cultural activities of the Northwest highlands.
  • Buckwheat flower fields: A new tourist destination in Ha Giang, famous for its colorful buckwheat flower fields creating a colorful and vibrant natural picture.
  • In addition, you can also join trekking tours, backpacking, explore terraced fields, or enjoy local specialties with the people of the rocky plateau.

It can be said that Ha Giang will bring visitors the most unforgettable experiences when visiting the rocky plateau. No matter what season of the year, Ha Giang always brings visitors the most beautiful memories.

How much does a trip to Vietnam cost?

This is always the top concern of many foreign tourists when they first set foot in Vietnam. However, the cost will vary depending on the preferences or budget that the tourist chooses.

  • Travel time
  • Location
  • Means of transportation
  • Accommodation
  • Entertainment and dining activities you choose

However, the prices are all listed, depending on whether you choose budget or luxury services, so the cost will be different, many people often choose luxury resorts, but on the contrary, some people choose budget to experience with the locals, and enjoy snacks.
